recipes.name: Sweet & Spicy Miso Roasted Sweet Potatoes with Sambal Tahini Mayo
instructions: Line a baking tray and preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C)*.
If desired, keep the skin on the potatoes as we did for extra crispiness and fibre. Cut the sweet potatoes into wedges.
In a large bowl, combine the oil, miso, sambal, maple syrup, and ginger. Use a fork to mix.
Add the sweet potato wedges to the bowl and toss to coat.
Transfer to the baking tray and roast for 35 to 40 minutes, or until tender and golden on the edges*.
Meanwhile, mix all the tahini mayo ingredients in a small bowl.
Serve the potato wedges with the tahini mayo, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † White miso, also called "Shiro Miso," is fermented for less time than red miso, which gives it a milder, sweeter flavour. If substituting red miso, use a smaller amount and adjust to taste, as red miso is saltier and stronger. * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection). * Optional tip: once the potatoes are cooked, turn on the broiler and broil for 1 to 2 minutes. Be sure to use a broiler-safe pan and remove any lining unsafe for high heat, such as parchment paper.
Storage Best enjoyed fresh out of the oven. Store leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
